q: The Parry measure (measure of maximal entropy) for an irreducible SFT with adjacency matrix A assigns to each cylinder set a probability determined by:
opts: Left and right Perron eigenvectors of A
The unique stationary distribution of the Markov chain
The square root of each entry of A
exp: The Parry measure is the unique measure of maximal entropy for an irreducible SFT. It is the Markov measure with transition probabilities Pᵢⱼ = Aᵢⱼ vⱼ/(ρ vᵢ), where ρ = spectral radius and u, v are Perron eigenvectors.
